articles.summary: Unity's AI tools in beta includes a 3D Object Generator capable of creating static 3D mesh prefabs from text prompts or reference images. Generated objects are single-part, non-rigged props suited to environment details, household items, and decorative assets. Generate directly from the Generators window or through the in-editor AI Assistant using natural language. Results are saved to the Assets folder as prefabs containing a mesh and materials. Requires Unity 6.0+ with the AI beta package installed.
articles.title: Unity's AI tools in beta: Create props with the 3D Object Generator
